title: Customer commencement runway and release synchronization
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Create an operational playbook and release-note cadence that synchronizes Product, Engineering, Design, Support, and GTM for targeted beta activations (initial anchor accounts + 10 pilot customers). The deliverable is a single canonical checklist, a release-notes template with legal/SE-approved copy, an internal launch runbook (on-call, rollback, fallback configs), and dashboards for pre/post-launch signals. Focus areas: (1) clear canary criteria across Dedicated/Hosted/Private deployments, (2) release notes coordination and customer-facing language, (3) feedback loop for rapid regressions tied to evals and prompt-sets, (4) operational handoffs to CS/Support and engineering playbooks for rollback/fallback to cheaper model variants.
